# obs.dividend_expectation r1

obs.dividend_expectation r1: one answer about the expected dividend of one instrument on one day (IBKR generic tick 456); append only, an error is a row and a later success is a new attempt. IBKR does not say declared or projected, so every ex-date is projected.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| session_day | string (date) | no | Session day (XNYS) the row answers for. |
| instrument_id | integer | no | Instrument (IBKR contract id) the row answers for. |
| attempt | integer | no | Attempt number of the day, from 1; a later attempt never replaces an earlier row. |
| issuer | string | no | The issuer text of the watch list: cik:<10 digits>, or edinet:<code>. |
| status | enum(present, no_value, unsupported, error) | no | present: the tick gave a parsable next ex-date and amount; no_value: the tick gave none (a non-payer or no answer in time); unsupported: the market failed its probe and is not asked; error: the request failed. Only present carries next_ex_date and next_amount. |
| past_12m | string | yes | Dividends per share of the past 12 months as decimal text; null when the tick gave none. |
| next_12m | string | yes | Dividends per share expected in the next 12 months as decimal text; null when the tick gave none. |
| next_amount | string | yes | Next dividend per share as decimal text; null unless status is present. The key is always present. |
| next_ex_date | string (date) | yes | Next ex-dividend date, projected; null unless status is present. The key is always present. |
| currency | string | no | Currency of the contract asked, not a claim of the tick; empty when none. |
| error_code | string | no | Error code when status is error; empty otherwise. |
| source | enum(ibkr_tick_456, none) | no | Where the row came from; none is a status unsupported row, since no source produced it. Never null. |
| received_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the row was produced, UTC. |

Primary key: (session_day, instrument_id, attempt)
